artifacts.summary: Compression half of the witness-family route: every ZTime countermodel compresses to a bounded, canonically guessed WitnessFamily, giving Decidable (ValidZTime).

completion_data.completion_summary: Landed the completeness (compression) half of the witness-family route as seven new Lean modules under FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/WitnessFamily/Compression/: every ZTime countermodel of a formula provably compresses to a WitnessFamily whose lasso segments are bounded by compressionBound and whose box guess is the canonical enumerable form, and that family is a member of the computable candidate list cands. Composing with the landed soundness half yields Compression.decidableValidZTime : Decidable (ValidZTime phi) plus decidableSemanticConsequenceNil, all with zero sorry and axioms exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].
